summary.intent: Execute phase 19.2 gap closure plans for IPFS upload performance optimization, then replan the baseline comparison approach to use local dev instead of staging.
summary.outcome: Phase 19.2 executed successfully (concurrent pin orchestration + pebbleds datastore), but verification found 2 gaps: missing PERF-09 requirement and non-definitive baselines. Gap closure plans were created, then 19.2-04 was replanned to use a local three-point comparison (pre-optimization, SDK-only, SDK+Kubo) instead of a staging deployment.

repo: Phase 19.2 is IPFS upload performance optimization; primary bottleneck was sequential IPNS publish + folder metadata update in SDK upload flow

Pre/post baselines were captured in different environments (staging vs localhost) with different client counts (10 vs 5), making them non-comparable — environment consistency is critical for load test validity
PERF-09 requirement was referenced in plans but missing from REQUIREMENTS.md (which stopped at PERF-08) — a documentation gap that needed a dedicated gap closure plan
Local dev environment has pebbleds configured via Docker Compose at 192.168.133.114; switching datastores requires volume deletion (destructive)
Load test harness collects p50/p95/p99/min/max/avg latencies plus throughput per operation via tests/load/src/harness/metrics.ts
Three git checkpoint commits identified for local three-point comparison: parent of 4087fa2b6 (pre-optimization), 565dccd5d (SDK-only), and HEAD (SDK+Kubo)

code.finding: Upload throughput load test scenario available for baseline capture
Client pool harness used by load tests
Metrics harness collects p50/p95/p99/min/max/avg latency and throughput per operation

workflow: GSD gap closure flow: execute-phase → verifier finds gaps → plan-phase --gaps → execute-phase --gaps-only
When baselines compare different environments or conditions, verification correctly flags them as non-definitive — matched-condition testing is a must-have for performance claims
Replanning a single plan mid-gap-closure is viable: read existing plan, identify correct git checkpoints, rewrite with Write tool, commit
Staging IPFS volume deletion is destructive (requires re-pinning all content) — local dev is preferable for iterative baseline comparisons

friction: Post-optimization baselines were captured in a different environment with different client counts than pre-optimization baselines, requiring a gap closure plan just to get valid comparison data
PERF-09 was used in plan frontmatter but never registered in REQUIREMENTS.md, causing a verification failure that required a dedicated doc-fix plan
Staging deployment required pushing branch to remote and waiting for manual human action (docker compose down/up with volume deletion) before execution could continue
